meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据简报灵活创作多场景视频作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要制作多场景视频或品牌短片
copy.tagline_en: Create or edit multi-scene video compositions from a brief
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to produce multi-scene videos or brand reels

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会负责创作或修改自定义 HyperFrames 视频合成,适用于多场景影片、品牌片、蒙太奇、静态标题卡等。它会按项目简报规划场景、处理媒体素材,并遵守内嵌的媒体、动画和设计规范。
howto.when: 当没有更专门的视频工作流适用,或项目简报(BRIEF.md)中指定以 companion 模式协作时触发;也适用于长片、品牌短片、蒙太奇等自由构建场景。

say.text: 帮我把这些素材剪成一条30秒的品牌短片。
say.note: 会启动 general-video 流程,规划并生成短片。

say.text: 做一个多场景的蒙太奇,每个场景加一个标题卡。
say.note: 按多场景合成流程处理,产出带标题卡的蒙太奇。

say.text: 按 BRIEF.md 里的设定,以 companion 模式开始制作这个视频。
say.note: 会读取简报,按协作模式逐步推进。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude authors or edits custom HyperFrames video compositions for multi-scene pieces, brand reels, montages, static title cards, etc. It plans scenes, processes media assets, and follows built-in media, animation, and design rules.
howto.when_en: Triggered when no specialized video workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Also suited for longer pieces, brand reels, montages, and freeform builds.

say_en.text: Cut these assets into a 30-second brand reel.
say_en.note: Starts the general-video flow to plan and produce the reel.

say_en.text: Make a multi-scene montage with a title card per scene.
say_en.note: Runs the multi-scene pipeline with title cards.

say_en.text: Start this video in companion mode per BRIEF.md.
say_en.note: Reads the brief and proceeds collaboratively.
